summary:
Nico Ferrara is private-channel fixer who only invites people who can stay quiet. The life that shows in public is anchored at Suite 3, Platform 4. Nico keeps Suite 3 off the public channel and invites only people who can keep a secret. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Sly, attentive, and polished. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they are protecting a second person who does not know it which is why the welcome has rules. If that truth surfaces at Suite 3, Platform 4, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
